layout.demoNotice: This message was sent by a demo version of Med Connect. All people and data in it are fictional.
layout.ignore: If you didn’t request this, you can ignore this message.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address for Med Connect
verifyEmail.heading: Welcome to Med Connect
verifyEmail.body: To finish signing up, please verify your email address.
verifyEmail.expiry: This link is valid for 24 hours.

accountExists.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email address
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to sign up for Med Connect with this email address, but an account already exists for it.
accountExists.resetHint: Forgot your password? You can reset it from the sign-in page.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Med Connect password
passwordReset.heading: Password reset
passwordReset.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account.
passwordReset.expiry: This link is valid for one hour and can be used once.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Password changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your Med Connect account was changed, and all other sessions were signed out.
passwordChanged.notYou: If you didn’t make this change, reset your password immediately and contact the Med Connect team.

accountLocked.subject: Your account is temporarily locked
accountLocked.heading: Account temporarily locked
accountLocked.body: There were several failed sign-in attempts on your account, so it is locked for {minutes} minutes.
accountLocked.notYou: If this wasn’t you, we recommend resetting your password.

newDevice.subject: New sign-in to your account
newDevice.heading: New device sign-in
newDevice.body: Your account was signed in from {device} at {time}.
newDevice.notYou: If this wasn’t you, reset your password and sign out that session from the account security page.

membershipApplicationReceived.subject: We received your membership application
membershipApplicationReceived.heading: Application received
membershipApplicationReceived.body: We received your membership application ({typeName}). It will be reviewed, and we will email you at each step.

membershipDirectorApproved.subject: Your department director approved your application
membershipDirectorApproved.heading: Approved by your department director
membershipDirectorApproved.body: Your department director approved your membership application ({typeName}). It now goes to the organisation for final approval.

membershipApproved.subject: Your membership is approved
membershipApproved.heading: Your membership is approved
membershipApproved.body: Your membership application ({typeName}) was approved. Your membership is valid until {endDate}, and your digital membership card is ready.

membershipRejected.subject: Your membership application was not approved
membershipRejected.heading: Application not approved
membershipRejected.body: Your membership application ({typeName}) was not approved.

membershipImportWelcome.subject: Your Med Connect account is ready
membershipImportWelcome.heading: Welcome to Med Connect
membershipImportWelcome.body: An organisation you are a member of created a Med Connect account for you, with your membership ({typeName}). Set a password to sign in.
membershipImportWelcome.expiry: This link is valid for 7 days. After that, use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.

physicianVerificationReceived.subject: We received your request to be verified
physicianVerificationReceived.heading: Request received
physicianVerificationReceived.body: Thank you. A reviewer will check your details, usually within a few working days, and we will write to you with the answer.

physicianVerificationApproved.subject: You are verified
physicianVerificationApproved.heading: You are verified
physicianVerificationApproved.body: You are verified as {as}, until {until}. Everything open to verified physicians on the platform is open to you now.

physicianVerificationRejected.subject: Your request to be verified was not approved
physicianVerificationRejected.heading: Request not approved
physicianVerificationRejected.body: Your request to be verified was not approved. You may answer and ask again.

physicianVerificationRevoked.subject: Your verification was withdrawn
physicianVerificationRevoked.heading: Verification ended
physicianVerificationRevoked.body: Your verification was withdrawn. Your account stays; what is open to verified physicians is closed to you until you are verified again.

physicianVerificationExpiring.subject: Your verification ends on {until}
physicianVerificationExpiring.heading: Time to renew
physicianVerificationExpiring.body: Your verification ends on {until}. Ask to renew it now, so nothing closes in between.

physicianVerificationExpired.subject: Your verification has ended
physicianVerificationExpired.heading: Verification ended
physicianVerificationExpired.body: Your verification reached its date and has ended. Your account stays; ask again to be verified.

newsSentBack.subject: Your news item needs changes
newsSentBack.heading: Sent back for changes
newsSentBack.body: The reviewer sent “{title}” back to you.

newsPublished.subject: Your news item is published
newsPublished.heading: Published
newsPublished.body: “{title}” is now published on Med Connect.

eventWaitlisted.subject: You are on the waiting list: {title}
eventWaitlisted.heading: You are on the waiting list
eventWaitlisted.body: “{title}” is full, so you are on the waiting list. We will email you if a place opens.

eventPromoted.subject: A place opened for you: {title}
eventPromoted.heading: You have a place
eventPromoted.body: A place opened, and you are now registered for “{title}”, {when}.

educationSentBack.subject: Your education item needs changes
educationSentBack.heading: Sent back for changes
educationSentBack.body: The reviewer sent “{title}” back to you.

educationPublished.subject: Your education item is published
educationPublished.heading: Published
educationPublished.body: “{title}” is now published on Med Connect.

chatUnread.subject: Chat messages are waiting for you
chatUnread.heading: Unread chat messages
chatUnread.body: You have messages in the chat on Med Connect that you haven’t read. To keep them private, this email doesn’t show them or who sent them.
